page.meta_description: Explore upcoming Rise City ministry gatherings — online worship, in-person fellowship, and Bible study. Dates will be announced soon.
page.headline: EVENTS.
page.intro: Three ways to gather. One shared invitation to rise in faith, walk with Christ, and grow together.
page.status_text: Dates are being finalized. Explore the experiences below and check back for details on how to join.

featured.title: ROOM TO BELONG.
featured.introduction: Whether you are joining from your living room, sharing a meal, or opening Scripture, there is a place to grow together.

items.name: anywhere
items.summary: Worship, biblical teaching, and prayer—right where you are. Your connection to Rise City travels with you.
items.image_alt: Multicultural group participating in an online worship experience

items.name: connect
items.summary: A seat at the table, meaningful conversation, and genuine Christian community. Come share life together.
items.image_alt: Multicultural group enjoying fellowship around a meal

items.name: up and walk
items.summary: Explore the Word, ask honest questions, and take your next step in faith. Inspired by Acts 3:6.
items.highlight: OPEN THE WORD. WALK WITH CHRIST.
items.image_alt: Multicultural Bible study group gathered together

experience.introduction: Each expression is designed to create space for meaningful connection with Jesus and one another.

items.title: Christ-centered atmosphere
items.description: Every gathering points people to Jesus Christ through worship, conversation, prayer, and the Word.

items.title: A place to belong
items.description: New guests and familiar faces alike are welcomed into a warm, faith-filled environment.

items.title: Clear next steps
items.description: As dates are announced, each event will include simple details for joining, attending, and staying connected.

items.question: When will the dates be announced?
items.answer: Dates are still being finalized. Check back soon for event timing, registration, and additional details.

items.question: Will registration be required?
items.answer: Some gatherings may use registration so we can prepare well. If needed, a registration link will be shared once the event details are published.

items.question: Can I come if I am new to Rise City?
items.answer: Absolutely. Each gathering is designed to be welcoming for guests, friends, and anyone interested in learning more about Rise City.

items.question: Will these events happen regularly?
items.answer: These ministry expressions are part of the ongoing life of Rise City. Frequency and schedule details will be posted as plans are confirmed.

bottom.title: YOUR NEXT STEP STARTS HERE.
bottom.description: We are planning what comes next. Dates and ways to join will be shared as soon as they are confirmed.
